intro: Lesson 61: Revision: inequalities. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Solve (a) 7 − 3x ≥ 1 (b) 2x² − 5x − 3 < 0 (c) list the integers n with n² < 20
questions.model: (a) −3x ≥ −6, divide by −3 and reverse: x ≤ 2. (b) (2x + 1)(x − 3) < 0, roots −1/2 and 3, below the axis between: −1/2 < x < 3. (c) n² < 20 for −4 ≤ n ≤ 4.

questions.q: Find the integers x that satisfy both 3x + 2 > 5 and x² < 16.
Region R satisfies y ≥ 1, x + y ≤ 5 and y ≤ 2x. List all points with integer coordinates in R.
Is (2, 3) in the region y > 2x − 1 and x + y ≤ 6?
questions.a: No: 3 > 3 is false (it is on the boundary of a strict inequality)
